items.title: How to check recruitment requirements item by item?

values: Materials and setup｜All people, directories and processes are editorially fictional

You are the trainee information assistant at the Sunny Bridge service station, organizing resource candidates for the fictional number A17 and handing them to the supervisor for review. Do paper material comparisons only, contact no real person or agency, and process no appointments, benefits or care.

E1｜A17 wants to learn about community resource consultation, and the materials give only the attendable time slot as Tuesday 14:30—15:30. Transport, affordable cost and preferred contact channel are not provided; do not fill them in yourself. There are no health, financial or eligibility documents.

E2｜September 20 directory D1: resource consultation is offered Tuesday 14:00—16:00, marked as able to take 2 new consultations, but the latest remaining slots have not been verified; eligibility conditions must be confirmed by the service provider. Transport support is not stated, and a directory is not an appointment confirmation.

E3｜September 20 directory D2: Thursday 10:00—12:00, requiring professional referral; costs are not stated. The September 5 directory D3 once said consultation was available on Tuesdays, but the September 20 update notice says D3 suspended intake from September 18; old information must not be reused.

E4｜The station draft record says “A17 was successfully booked at D1 and confirmed eligible, and D3 can also serve as an alternative”. The existing materials contain no submission, acceptance or appointment confirmation evidence and no eligibility decision, so each statement must be corrected.

E5｜The trainee assistant only organizes needs, directories and contact drafts. The supervisor reviews records and referral routes, and the service provider confirms its conditions, slots and appointments; professional services and legal eligibility are handled by authorized persons. Real contact or processing is prohibited in this exercise.
Tasks and outputs

Using E1—E3, list facts, source dates and unknowns, and compare the times and acceptance status of D1—D3. Choose one conditional candidate and explain why it still cannot be written as already booked.

Correct E4 and write a one-page needs summary, resource comparison, unconfirmed list and supervisor handover; then draft an inquiry message for paper review only, without contacting real people or agencies.
Reference answers (finish independently first, then check)

D1's Tuesday 14:00—16:00 is compatible with E1's Tuesday 14:30—15:30 and can serve as a conditional candidate; “able to take 2” is not a reserved slot or confirmation of current availability, and eligibility, transport, cost and contact channel still need to be verified.

D2 Thursday 10:00—12:00 does not match the current Tuesday time slot and requires professional referral with unknown costs; availability cannot be claimed directly. D3 must be updated with September 20, as intake is suspended, and the old September 5 directory cannot be listed as a current option.

Correct E4 to: “D1 is a resource candidate pending supervisor review; eligibility, slots and appointment are not yet confirmed, and D3 has suspended intake.” Draft inquiry: “Please review D1's current acceptance conditions, available Tuesday slots and cost and transport information; after confirming A17's contact preference, contact only through the authorized process.” This is a draft only, with no actual sending or service decisions.
Boundaries and review

Materials are entirely fictional; do not contact real people, import cases, fabricate needs or evidence, or process benefits, clinical services or appointments. description.text: Under the direction of social workers, psychologists or other social service personnel, learn about help-seeking needs, look up resources, assist with forms, appointments and referrals, maintain records and follow up on services. The core task is to hand needs accurately to the right person and state conditions that are not yet confirmed; an assistant title grants no independent diagnosis, treatment, benefit determination or program budget approval.
